SELECT d.disease_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0)) * 100, 2) AS avgConfidence, ROUND(MAX(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0)) * 100, 2) AS maxConfidence, COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(MIN(d.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d'), '暂无记录') AS firstTime, COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(MAX(d.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d'), '暂无记录') AS latestTime, COALESCE(MAX(p.park_name), '未关联园区') AS parkName, MAX(d.disease_result) AS result, MAX(d.disease_desc) AS description, MAX(d.disease_advice) AS advice, COALESCE(MAX(d.disease_result_img_url), MAX(i.image_result_url), MAX(i.image_url)) AS imageUrl FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.device_id = COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) LEFT JOIN park p ON p.park_id = COALESCE(r.park_id, i.park_id, dev.location_id) WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY d.disease_name ORDER BY count DESC, d.disease_name

SELECT category.date, category.name, category.count, category.avgConfidence, daily.totalCount, daily.diseaseCount, ROUND(daily.diseaseCount * 100.0 / NULLIF(daily.totalCount, 0), 2) AS detectionRate FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, d.disease_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0)) * 100, 2) AS avgConfidence FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.device_id = COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), d.disease_name ) category INNER JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.disease_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.disease_name) <> '' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%健康%' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%正常%' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%无病虫害%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diseaseCount FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.device_id = COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) daily ON daily.date = category.date ORDER BY category.date, category.name

SELECT COALESCE(r.park_id, i.park_id, dev.location_id) AS parkId, COALESCE(p.park_name, '未关联园区') AS parkName, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_warning = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warningCount, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0)) * 100, 2) AS avgConfidence FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.device_id = COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) LEFT JOIN park p ON p.park_id = COALESCE(r.park_id, i.park_id, dev.location_id) WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY COALESCE(r.park_id, i.park_id, dev.location_id), p.park_name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT d.disease_id AS diseaseId, d.disease_name AS name, ROUND(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0) * 100, 2) AS confidence, COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '暂无记录') AS time, COALESCE(r.model_name, '未知模型') AS model, COALESCE(p.park_name, '未关联园区') AS parkName, CASE WHEN r.plot_id IS NULL THEN '未关联地块' ELSE CONCAT('地块', r.plot_id) END AS plotName, i.image_name AS imageName, COALESCE(d.disease_result_img_url, i.image_result_url, i.image_url) AS imageUrl FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.device_id = COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) LEFT JOIN park p ON p.park_id = COALESCE(r.park_id, i.park_id, dev.location_id) WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC, d.disease_id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT park_id AS parkId, park_name AS parkName FROM park ORDER BY park_id

SELECT device_id AS deviceId, COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name, ''), device_sn, CONCAT('设备', device_id)) AS deviceName, location_id AS parkId FROM iot_device WHERE 1 = 1 AND location_id = #{parkId} ORDER BY location_id, device_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(base.stat_time, '%m-%d %H:00') AS time, COALESCE(recognition.total_count, 0) AS totalCount, COALESCE(recognition.disease_count, 0) AS diseaseCount, CASE WHEN recognition.total_count IS NULL OR recognition.total_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(recognition.disease_count * 100.0 / recognition.total_count, 2) END AS detectionRate, weather.temperature, weather.humidity, weather.precipitation FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(report_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS stat_time FROM ld_agri_weather_live WHERE AND CAST(park_id AS UNSIGNED) = #{parkId} AND CAST(park_id AS UNSIGNED) = (SELECT location_id FROM iot_device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}) UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(f.forecast_date, '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AS stat_time FROM ld_agri_weather_forecast f WHERE AND CAST(f.park_id AS UNSIGNED) = #{parkId} AND CAST(f.park_id AS UNSIGNED) = (SELECT location_id FROM iot_device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ld_agri_weather_live live WHERE DATE(live.report_time) = f.forecast_date AND CAST(live.park_id AS UNSIGNED) = #{parkId} AND CAST(live.park_id AS UNSIGNED) = (SELECT location_id FROM iot_device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}) ) GROUP BY f.forecast_date UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS stat_time FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.device_id = COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) WHERE d.create_time IS NOT NULL AND r.record_type = '病虫害' AND r.record_mode = '自动定时'
AND COALESCE(r.park_id, i.park_id, dev.location_id) = #{parkId} AND COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) = #{deviceId} ) base LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(report_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS stat_time, ROUND(AVG(temperature), 2) AS temperature, ROUND(AVG(humidity), 2) AS humidity, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(precipitation, 0)), 2) AS precipitation FROM ld_agri_weather_live WHERE AND CAST(park_id AS UNSIGNED) = #{parkId} AND CAST(park_id AS UNSIGNED) = (SELECT location_id FROM iot_device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(report_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(f.forecast_date, '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AS stat_time, ROUND(AVG((f.temp_max + f.temp_min) / 2), 2) AS temperature, ROUND(AVG(f.humidity_avg), 2) AS humidity, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(f.precip_total, 0)), 2) AS precipitation FROM ld_agri_weather_forecast f INNER JOIN ( SELECT forecast_date, park_id, MAX(fetch_time) AS fetch_time FROM ld_agri_weather_forecast WHERE AND CAST(park_id AS UNSIGNED) = #{parkId} AND CAST(park_id AS UNSIGNED) = (SELECT location_id FROM iot_device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}) GROUP BY forecast_date, park_id ) latest ON latest.forecast_date = f.forecast_date AND latest.park_id = f.park_id AND latest.fetch_time = f.fetch_time WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ld_agri_weather_live live WHERE DATE(live.report_time) = f.forecast_date AND CAST(live.park_id AS UNSIGNED) = #{parkId} AND CAST(live.park_id AS UNSIGNED) = (SELECT location_id FROM iot_device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}) ) GROUP BY f.forecast_date ) weather ON weather.stat_time = base.stat_time LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS stat_time, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN d.disease_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.disease_name) <> ''
AND d.disease_name = #{environmentDiseaseName}
AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%健康%' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%正常%' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%无病虫害%'
THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disease_count FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.device_id = COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) WHERE d.create_time IS NOT NULL AND r.record_type = '病虫害' AND r.record_mode = '自动定时'
AND COALESCE(r.park_id, i.park_id, dev.location_id) = #{parkId} AND COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) = #{deviceId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ) recognition ON recognition.stat_time = base.stat_time ORDER BY base.stat_time ASC

SELECT recognition.stat_date AS date, recognition.disease_name AS diseaseName, recognition.total_count AS totalCount, recognition.disease_count AS diseaseCount, weather.temperature, weather.humidity, weather.rainfall FROM ( SELECT disease_daily.stat_date, disease_daily.disease_name, total_daily.total_count, disease_daily.disease_count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date, d.disease_name, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM xwq_ai_disease d INNER JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.device_id = COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) WHERE d.create_time IS NOT NULL AND d.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND r.record_type = '病虫害' AND r.record_mode IS NOT NULL AND (r.record_mode LIKE '%自动%' OR r.record_mode LIKE '%定时%') AND d.disease_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.disease_name) <> '' AND COALESCE(r.park_id, i.park_id, dev.location_id) = #{parkId} AND COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) = #{deviceId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), d.disease_name ) disease_daily INNER JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM xwq_ai_disease d INNER JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id LEFT JOIN iot_device dev ON dev.device_id = COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) WHERE d.create_time IS NOT NULL AND d.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND r.record_type = '病虫害' AND r.record_mode IS NOT NULL AND (r.record_mode LIKE '%自动%' OR r.record_mode LIKE '%定时%') AND COALESCE(r.park_id, i.park_id, dev.location_id) = #{parkId} AND COALESCE(r.device_id, i.device_id) = #{deviceId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) total_daily ON total_daily.stat_date = disease_daily.stat_date ) recognition INNER JOIN ( SELECT station.stat_date, ROUND(AVG(station.temperature), 2) AS temperature, ROUND(AVG(station.humidity), 2) AS humidity, ROUND(AVG(station.rainfall), 2) AS rainfall FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(report_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date, park_id, AVG(temperature) AS temperature, AVG(humidity) AS humidity, SUM(COALESCE(precipitation, 0)) AS rainfall FROM ld_agri_weather_live WHERE report_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND CAST(park_id AS UNSIGNED) = #{parkId} AND CAST(park_id AS UNSIGNED) = (SELECT location_id FROM iot_device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(report_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), park_id ) station GROUP BY station.stat_date ) weather ON weather.stat_date = recognition.stat_date ORDER BY recognition.stat_date DESC LIMIT 30
